name: 92324 · Colton, CA
findings: ZIP 92324 (Colton) has 120 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 29 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92324 (Colton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 92324 (Colton) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
